quotes.text: I believe we need to slow down data centers. We need accountability to make sure: 1. Local communities have total control over whether a center is built; 2. No one ever pays more for electricity to subsidize a data center  3. Data centers don't get special tax breaks.
And I believe we need strong protections to make sure AI does not displace workers or leave working people worse off.

Proud today to announce our campaign's endorsement by the @CleStateDems!

As a proud dad of a CSU grad, this endorsement means the world to me. But further, this is a tough time for young people in our country. With a faltering economy, rising costs, and AI and automation threatening this generation's prospects, I'm proud to have their support as we fight to ensure we put #workersfirst, and build an economy that works for the working class, not just billionaires.

I’m very concerned about it…that’s going to drive the demand for workers way down and then wages will subsequently follow [...] Congress must do whatever they can do to make sure that doesn’t happen, and I think that’s why we need to pump the brakes on AI
